title: Jude and the House
author: Mirabel Vasquez
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
